title: Plan your Self-Adaptation! Ontology-Mediated Task and Architecture Co-adaptation Planning for Robots
abstract: arXiv:2611.25254v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous robots may need to adapt both their task plans and architectural configurations as operating conditions change. These decisions are interdependent: architectural configurations determine which actions a robot can perform, while task plans determine which capabilities are required. This paper presents PLANTA, an ontology-mediated approach to task and architecture co-adaptation that considers these dependencies during mission planning. PLANTA uses an ontology expressed in the Web Ontology Language to represent architectural alternatives and their associated functional and quality requirements, while the Planning Domain Definition Language defines task actions and mission goals. By automatically translating and integrating these models, PLANTA enables joint planning of task and reconfiguration actions. translated_title: 规划你的自适应！基于本体的机器人任务与架构协同自适应规划
translated_abstract: 自主机器人可能需要在运行条件发生变化时，同时调整其任务规划和架构配置。这些决策是相互依赖的：架构配置决定了机器人能够执行哪些动作，而任务规划则决定了需要哪些能力。本文提出了PLANTA，一种基于本体的任务与架构协同自适应方法，能够在任务规划过程中考虑这些依赖关系。PLANTA使用以Web本体语言（OWL）表达的本体来表示架构备选方案及其相关的功能和质量需求，同时使用规划领域定义语言（PDDL）来定义任务动作和任务目标。通过自动翻译和集成这些模型，PLANTA实现了任务动作与重构动作的联合规划。该方法采用满意规划技术，并在执行过程中发生变更导致当前计划失效时进行重新规划。PLANTA的评估（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出PLANTA方法，利用OWL本体表示架构备选方案、PDDL定义任务目标，实现了机器人任务规划与架构重构的联合协同规划，并能根据执行中的变化进行重规划。
en_tdlr: PLANTA is an ontology-mediated approach that jointly plans robot task actions and architectural reconfigurations by combining OWL-based architecture modeling with PDDL-based task planning, with replanning capabilities when execution changes invalidate the current plan.
